name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. [1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years. [2]
key_points: Overview [1] NFIL, a part of the Padmanabh Mafatlal group, is present in the fluorochemical industry since 1967 and is one of the largest specialty fluorochemical companies and a pioneer in manufacturing of refrigerant gases in India. NFIL’s product portfolio comprises 60+ fluorinated compounds, with them finding application in various industries, like agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, aluminium smelting, refrigeration, metal processing, abrasives, glass and ceramics. The company is currently headed by second-generation entrepreneur, Vishad Mafatlal, who has over 25 years’ experience in textile and chemical sectors

profile.summary: Navin Fluorine International Limited manufactures and sells specialty fluorochemicals in India and internationally. The company offers refrigerants for various applications, including room air conditioning, commercial refrigeration, industrial cooling, mobile air conditioning, cold chain, and heat pumps under the Mafron brand for original equipment manufacturers, service technicians, and equipment owners. It also provides inorganic fluoride products, such as hydrogen fluoride, diluted hydrofluoric acid, ammonium bifluoride, potassium fluoride, sodium fluoride, hexafluorophosphoric acid, hydrogen fluoridepyridine complex, and fluoboric acid for oil and gas, steel and abrasives, industrial glass and specialty performance materials, pharmaceutical and agrochemicals, and medical surface treatment applications; and specialty fluorochemicals comprising benzotrifluoride, 2-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine, 4-fluorophenol, 3-aminobenzotrifluoride, 4-fluorobenzonitrile, 4-fluorobenzoic acid, and 3-chlorobenzotrifluoride. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Mumbai, India.
